name: Boone County, MO
findings: Boone County has 806 nonprofit organizations. 401 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 339 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Boone County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
